Refactored the design so the algorithm no longer depends on a concrete graph class and the domain model no longer owns string formatting.

The main changes are:
- Added [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/Graph.java:1) and updated [DirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/DirectedGraph.java:1) to implement it. `KosarajuStronglyConnectedComponentsFinder` and `DepthFirstTraversal` now work against the `Graph` abstraction instead of `DirectedGraph` directly.
- Moved presentation out of the result/domain types into [StronglyConnectedComponentsFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/StronglyConnectedComponentsFormatter.java:1). [StronglyConnectedComponentsResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/StronglyConnectedComponentsResult.java:1) and [StronglyConnectedComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/StronglyConnectedComponent.java:1) are now pure domain objects, and the demo entrypoint in [StronglyConnectedComponents.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/StronglyConnectedComponents.java:1) formats output explicitly.
